# Toolchanger data

> A vocabulary for 3D printer toolchangers, and a table of the machines that use
> each kind. Systems get sorted by where the tool/carriage split is drawn, because
> that is what sets the cost per tool, the moving mass, and what has to be broken
> and remade at every change. Three classes, eight subtypes.

Site: https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/  ·  Source: https://github.com/robertsamples/toolchanger-data
Generated from data/ by tools/build-docs.mjs. Not hand-written.

## How the classification works

Every subtype is one block diagram of a toolhead with a dashed outline drawn round
the part that leaves with a tool change. Blocks inside the outline exist once per
tool; connections crossing it are broken and remade at every change. The blocks are:
Filament, AMS, Mainboard, Toolhead board, Motor, Gears, Part cooling fan, Hotend fan, Heatsink, Nozzle.

Each subtype page also carries pros and cons; those are not repeated here.

Classes differ in where that outline falls:

- Conventional toolchangers — Full conventional; Partial conventional
- Filament path changers — Gear swapping path changers; Hotend fan swapping path changers; Inductive / pogo path changers; Wired path changers
- Hotend changers — AMS-assisted hotend changers; AMS-assisted nozzle changers

## Conventional toolchangers

### Full conventional

https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/subtypes/full-conventional/

Travels with the tool: Toolhead board, Motor, Gears, Part cooling fan, Hotend fan, Heatsink, Nozzle.

The whole toolhead is functionally a tool with a basic carriage being coupled to the belt. Each tool carries its own extruder motor, gears, fans, heat break and sometimes a toolhead board. The oldest type of 3D printer toolchanger.

Systems (8):
- Prusa XL — Commercial printer, up to 6 tools, 14 s change, $3899 — https://youtu.be/oO8XnWPwyjA?t=770
- E3D toolchanger — Commercial printer, up to 5 tools, 30 s change — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C7wYfaHT1g0
- Stealthchanger (DraftShift) — FOSS design, up to 8 tools, 60 s change, $1909 — https://github.com/DraftShift/StealthChanger
- TapChanger — FOSS design, up to 8 tools, 20 s change, $1775 — https://github.com/viesturz/tapchanger
- Madmax — FOSS design, up to 8 tools, 20 s change — https://github.com/zruncho3d/madmax
- Daksh — FOSS design, up to 8 tools, 20 s change — https://github.com/ankurv2k6/daksh-toolchanger-v2
- Lineux — FOSS design, up to 8 tools, 20 s change — https://github.com/Bikin-Creative/Lineux-Toolchanger
- Misschanger — FOSS design, up to 8 tools, 40 s change — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eGr8pHkFFNs

### Partial conventional

https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/subtypes/partial-conventional/

Travels with the tool: Motor, Gears, Hotend fan, Heatsink, Nozzle.
Split through: Toolhead board.

The tool keeps the extruder and the hot end but leaves the part cooling fan on the carriage, along with some of the toolhead electronics.

Systems (2):
- Snapmaker U1 — Commercial printer, up to 4 tools, 14 s change, $849 — https://youtu.be/NhL_kTRVEIo?t=186
- Snapmaker U1+Sidecar AMS — Commercial printer, up to 16 tools, 90 s change — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7EH3QAjspt0&t=1s

## Filament path changers

### Gear swapping path changers

https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/subtypes/gear-swapping/

Travels with the tool: Gears, Hotend fan, Heatsink, Nozzle.

The extruder motor stays on the carriage and the drive gears travel with the tool along with the hot end. The split is in the middle of the extruder.

Systems (1):
- Flashforge Creator 5 (C5) — Commercial printer, up to 4 tools, 14 s change, $699 — https://youtu.be/WA6FuC-_R_M?si=S3VlhMhHqDrbSSmb

### Hotend fan swapping path changers

https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/subtypes/hotend-fan-swapping/

Travels with the tool: Hotend fan, Heatsink, Nozzle.

The hot end travels with its own heat break fan. The extruder and part cooling stay behind, the extruder gears open for filament path changes.

Systems (6):
- Sovol M1D — Commercial printer, up to 7 tools, 21 s change, $1199 — https://www.sovol3d.com/pages/sovol-m1d-landing-page
- A4T-C — FOSS design, up to 8 tools, 15 s change — https://discord.com/channels/460117602945990666/1522282695516885204
- MedusaHC — FOSS design, up to 10 tools, 19 s change — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hpV5Z1TnGdY
- EMNA E3NG — FOSS design, up to 6 tools, 15 s change — https://github.com/emna2881/E3NG-Toolchanger
- Lineux HotSwap — FOSS design, up to 2 tools, 15 s change — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sOk1mblA44g
- INDEX-OOSAKA Vβ — FOSS design — https://www.printables.com/model/1630327-index-oosaka-vb

### Inductive / pogo path changers

https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/subtypes/inductive-pogo/

Travels with the tool: Heatsink, Nozzle.

Only the heat break and nozzle travel. The heater and thermistor cross the joint through spring pins or by inductive control, so nothing is plugged in by hand.

Systems (4):
- Infimech MX — Commercial printer, up to 8 tools, 20 s change — https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infimech-mx-series/infimech-mx-3d-printer-8x-more-efficiency-8x-less-waste
- Bondtech INDX — Commercial toolhead, up to 10 tools, 21 s change — https://youtu.be/BCmGoP0uNlM
- Quindec (Srin) — FOSS design, up to 20 tools, 20 s change — https://youtu.be/941lrKT-fIY
- Prusa CoreOne INDX — Commercial printer, up to 8 tools, 21 s change, $1949 — https://youtube.com/shorts/3wsolb-Yqn8?si=t8wk4CetKj_t3Ci_

### Wired path changers

https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/subtypes/wired/

Travels with the tool: Heatsink, Nozzle.

The same split as inductive/pogo, but the heater and thermistor stay on a wire back to the board instead of crossing a contact.

Systems (8):
- Ronin (Jakob) — FOSS design, up to ? tools, 15 s change — https://github.com/jaak0b/Ronin/tree/main
- Creality KliTek — Commercial printer, up to 4 tools, 20 s change — https://x.com/ZombieHedgehog_/status/2058981825842720972?s=20
- CxChanger — FOSS design, up to 5 tools, 15 s change — https://github.com/cx330-TXY/CxChanger/tree/main
- YUDX — FOSS design, up to 10 tools, 15 s change — https://github.com/dumplinglab/YUDX-tool-changer
- Axiloop MC8 — Commercial printer, up to 8 tools, 20 s change — https://www.reddit.com/r/Axiloop/
- BBox — FOSS design, up to 8 tools, 12 s change — https://youtube.com/shorts/VmdlazyVDtU?si=j0SshEQh-DE4e7WA
- Unnamed toolchanger (engineers grow) — FOSS design, up to 10 tools, 20 s change — https://youtu.be/wjNQ7pUC6R8?t=1059
- Unnamed toolchanger (Matti) — FOSS design, up to 10 tools, 20 s change — https://youtu.be/SmmD324tIl0?t=605

## Hotend changers

### AMS-assisted hotend changers

https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/subtypes/ams-assisted-hotend-changer/

Travels with the tool: Heatsink, Nozzle.

A hot end changer paired with an automatic material system. The AMS handles filament, so the tool only carries the heat break and nozzle.

Systems (1):
- H2C Vortek — Commercial printer, up to 7 tools, 42 s change — https://youtube.com/shorts/zYmmw5OM6OU?si=rIB2sr1aIYqg3bvJ

### AMS-assisted nozzle changers

https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/subtypes/ams-assisted-nozzle-changer/

Travels with the tool: Nozzle.

Only the nozzle is swapped. The heat break, fans and extruder all stay on the machine and the AMS feeds filament.

Systems (2):
- AtomForm Palette 300 — Commercial printer, up to 36 tools, 12 s change — https://atomform.tech/
- Swapper3d (Bigbrain3d) — Commercial toolhead, up to 20 tools, 90 s change — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AdUUCHGjXkE

## Not toolchangers

Listed on the site for comparison, but outside the classification above: AMS and
MMU units that multiplex filament into one hot end, IDEX and other multi-head
machines, colour deposition, and virtual-colour techniques.
See https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/all-systems/

- Every system as CSV: https://github.com/robertsamples/toolchanger-data/blob/main/data/systems.csv

- All pages: https://toolchangers.baconmilkshake.com/sitemap.xml

The toolchanger tables were compiled by https://github.com/ukdavewood.
Diagrams, taxonomy and site by https://github.com/robertsamples.
